metadata.dataset_name: Origin-country eligibility list for regional-content attribution
metadata.provenance: SYNTHETIC SUBSET, held in data rather than hardcoded in tools.py so the eligible-origin set can be swapped for an authoritative AfCFTA State Party / ratification list without touching calculation code.
metadata.note: Membership in eligible_origins is what makes a component's cost count toward african_sourced_cost. known_external_origins are recognised trading partners that correctly do NOT count; listing them lets verification tell 'legitimately imported' apart from 'we could not interpret this string', so the reviewer is shown only the latter. Country matching is case-insensitive and whitespace-normalised. Anything in neither list is treated as non-eligible (the conservative direction) AND flagged for human attention.
